Register wiw_industry, wiw_sector, wiw_profession, wiw_org_type and hierarchical wiw_place with ISO code as term meta
Register custom post status wiw_hidden (non-public, not queryable)

Seed place terms: Nigeria first, other African countries, pan-African bodies (cities added as needed)
acceptance: wiw_profile is not reachable through the core REST API, feeds, archives or core search

issues.notes: Seed values for the controlled lists (industry, sector, profession, org type) are an open point (contract U5); this issue registers the taxonomies and the place seed only. The import mapping step (M1-IMP-06) handles unknown terms.
